$comment: Hardware (device-lane) toolchain record. RETURN-4 P2-1 requires the
Maestro CLI to be pinned by VERSION and ARTIFACT CHECKSUM, because the
flow validator's per-command payload schemas are only meaningful
against a known CLI version, and because an unverified CLI download is
an unreviewed binary on the machine that sees the enrollment QR.
The build container cannot fill these values: outbound HTTPS to the
Maestro release host is denied by organization egress policy (the
gateway answered 403 to CONNECT on 2026-08-22), and no checksum may be
invented. The fields below are therefore an operator-fill HOLD with
exact commands. scripts/maestro-enroll-runner.mjs reads this record and
REFUSES to run any flow while status is not 'pinned' or while the
installed CLI version differs from the pinned version.
To fill (on the QA machine, Kody or the QA lead):
1. Download the release artifact for the chosen version from the
official Maestro release page and record its exact URL.
2. shasum -a 256 <artifact>   # record the 64-hex digest below
3. Install it, then: maestro --version   # must equal `version`
4. Set status to 'pinned' and record verifiedBy / verifiedOn.
Re-running maestro:validate after filling this record is required: the
payload schemas are declared to match this exact version.

maestro.schemaBasis: scripts/maestro-validate.mjs per-command payload schemas are declared against the pinned version recorded here

deviceLane.reason: No device, simulator, or Maestro binary in the build container; execution waits for PM PASS of the corrective candidate and Kody's machine reservation
